_comment: Cards for tests/unit/combat/test_attack_requirement_defender.py. `t_hungry_titan` is Galactus, Devourer of Worlds' third line alone on a vanilla body: an `attacks_if_able` static naming `defending: opponent_most_life`, switched off while its controller controls a creature named `Test Herald` (`t_test_herald`). `t_hungry_brute` is the near miss -- the same requirement without `defending`, which any attack obeys.

cards.name: Test Hungry Titan
cards.oracle_text: Test Hungry Titan attacks an opponent with the most life among your opponents each combat if able unless you control a creature named Test Herald.

abilities.text: Test Hungry Titan attacks an opponent with the most life among your opponents each combat if able unless you control a creature named Test Herald.

cards.name: Test Hungry Brute
cards.oracle_text: Test Hungry Brute attacks each combat if able.
